_comment: One spoken quip per story for the week's Reel (scripts/ig-reel.py). Real spellings; the script applies the LEXICON's TTS respellings itself. Keep each under about fifteen words — it is said and shown.
intro: Seventeen things in South Knoxville this weekend. Costumes optional, mostly.
outro: That's the weekend. The whole briefing is at soknoear.com. Link in bio.

quips.spooky-streets: Sevier Avenue closes for trick-or-treating Friday, five to seven thirty. Free.
quips.scruffy-roots-fest-oct-25: Scruffy Roots Fest got its new date: six acts on the Kern's lawn Sunday, free.
quips.john-borderland: Annie Baker's John opens at the Borderland Playhouse Thursday. Twenty dollars, four nights.
quips.best-if-used-by: A free readers' theatre closes the weekend at the Borderland Playhouse, Sunday at seven.
quips.big-pink-house-party: A whole night of drum and bass at the Pink Cactus Friday at nine.
quips.industrial-night-fbn: Captain Ed and FreQ-K play industrial slammers at Fly by Night Thursday.
quips.vampire-night-fbn: A vampire night for the sapphic crowd at Fly by Night Saturday. Fangs required.
quips.trailhead-rodney-lee: Rodney Lee and Corey Kimbro on the Trailhead patio, Friday at seven.
quips.trailhead-lonetones: The Lonetones close the weekend on the Trailhead patio, Sunday at four.
quips.rail-trail-tree-planting: Plant thirty-seven trees on the SoKno Rail Trail Thursday morning. Register free.
quips.monsters-workshop-kerns: Kids in costume sew their own monsters at Kern's Thursday, for a cause.
quips.printshop-vols-pints: A dollar off pints at Printshop for the whole Vols game Saturday, from three.
quips.enchanted-forest: Life-size puppets and candy in the woods: the Enchanted Forest at Ijams Nature Center, Saturday.
quips.mischief-night: Mischief Night: a headlamp hike with the nocturnal animals at Ijams Nature Center, Friday at seven.
quips.hunter-moon-paddle: The last paddle of the season, under the Hunter Moon, Sunday at six thirty.
quips.crossword-play: A crossword gets built live on stage at Ijams Nature Center, Sunday at two.
quips.specials-board: Earl's runs its Vols board for South Carolina on Saturday. Kickoff is three thirty.
